title: Getting started with gsm.vizr
text: Three layers, one owner . gsm.viz JavaScript library: decides bar chart looks behaves, documentation source truth every spec key. gsm.vizr package: vendors one copy gsm.viz bundle, owns R--JavaScript serialization contract, ships Shiny, event proxy plumbing. Report packages — gsm.qtl, gsm.kri, gsm.endpoints rest — build data frames specs hand . wrapper deliberately thin. R lists map 1:1 onto JS spec, second vocabulary learn translation layer fall behind upstream.

title: Group Overview Widget — Widget_GroupOverview
text: dfResults data.frame stacked summary analysis pipeline output. Created passing list results returned gsm.core::Summarize() gsm.reporting::BindResults(). Expected columns: GroupID, GroupLevel, Numerator, Denominator, Metric, Score, Flag, MetricID, StudyID, SnapshotDate. dfMetrics data.frame Metric-specific metadata use charts reporting. Created passing lWorkflow object gsm.reporting::MakeMetric(). Expected columns: File, MetricID, Group, Abbreviation, Metric, Numerator, Denominator, Model, Score, Threshold. details see Data Model vignette: vignette("DataModel", package = "gsm.core"). dfGroups data.frame Group-level metadata dictionary. Created passing CTMS site study data gsm.mapping::MakeLongMeta(). Expected columns: GroupID, GroupLevel, Param, Value. strGroupLevel character Value group level. Default: NULL taken dfMetrics$GroupLevel available. strGroupSubset character Subset groups include table. Default: 'red'. Options: '': groups. 'red': Groups 1+ red flags. 'red/amber': Groups 1+ red/amber flag. 'amber': Groups 1+ amber flag. strGroupLabelKey character Value group label key. Default: 'InvestigatorLastName'. strSiteRiskMetric character Metric ID site risk score. Default: 'Analysis_srs0001'. strOutputLabel character Label describing output object, assigned output_label attribute output object appears report generated gsm.kri::Report_KRI(). bDebug logical Print debug messages? Default: FALSE. ... Additional chart configuration settings.

title: Scatter Plot Widget — Widget_ScatterPlot
text: dfResults data.frame stacked summary analysis pipeline output. Created passing list results returned gsm.core::Summarize() gsm.reporting::BindResults(). Expected columns: GroupID, GroupLevel, Numerator, Denominator, Metric, Score, Flag, MetricID, StudyID, SnapshotDate. lMetric list Metric-specific metadata use charts reporting. Created passing lWorkflow object gsm.reporting::MakeMetric() turning list. Expected columns: File,MetricID, Group, Abbreviation, Metric, Numerator, Denominator, Model, Score, strThreshold. details see Data Model vignette: vignette("DataModel", package = "gsm.core"). dfGroups data.frame Group-level metadata dictionary. Created passing CTMS site study data gsm.mapping::MakeLongMeta(). Expected columns: GroupID, GroupLevel, Param, Value. dfBounds data.frame Set predicted percentages/rates upper- lower-bounds across full range sample sizes/total exposure values reporting. Created passing dfResults dfMetrics gsm.reporting::MakeBounds(). Expected columns: Threshold, Denominator, Numerator, Metric, MetricID, StudyID, SnapshotDate. bAddGroupSelect logical Add dropdown highlight sites? Default: TRUE. strShinyGroupSelectID character Element ID group select Shiny context. Default: 'GroupID'. strOutputLabel character Label describing output object, assigned output_label attribute output object appears report generated gsm.kri::Report_KRI(). bDebug logical Print debug messages? Default: FALSE. ... Additional chart configuration settings.

title: Shiny bindings for Widget_TimeSeries — Widget_TimeSeries-shiny
text: Output render functions using Widget_TimeSeries within Shiny applications interactive Rmd documents.

title: Shiny bindings for Widget_TimeSeries — Widget_TimeSeries-shiny
code: Widget_TimeSeriesOutput(outputId, width = "100%", height = "400px")  renderWidget_TimeSeries(expr, env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE)

title: Shiny bindings for Widget_TimeSeries — Widget_TimeSeries-shiny
text: outputId output variable read width, height Must valid CSS unit (like '100%', '400px', 'auto') number, coerced string 'px' appended. expr expression generates Widget_TimeSeries env environment evaluate expr. quoted expr quoted expression (quote())? useful want save expression variable.

title: Time Series Widget — Widget_TimeSeries
text: widget generates time series group-level metric results time, plotting snapshot date x-axis outcome (numerator, denominator, metric, score) y-axis.

title: Time Series Widget — Widget_TimeSeries
code: Widget_TimeSeries(   dfResults,   lMetric = NULL,   dfGroups = NULL,   vThreshold = NULL,   strOutcome = "Score",   vOutcomeOptions = c("Score", "Metric", "Numerator"),   bAddGroupSelect = TRUE,   strShinyGroupSelectID = "GroupID",   strOutputLabel = paste0(fontawesome::fa("chart-line", fill = "#337ab7"),     "  Time Series"),   bDebug = FALSE,   ... )

title: Time Series Widget — Widget_TimeSeries
text: dfResults data.frame stacked summary analysis pipeline output. Created passing list results returned gsm.core::Summarize() gsm.reporting::BindResults(). Expected columns: GroupID, GroupLevel, Numerator, Denominator, Metric, Score, Flag, MetricID, StudyID, SnapshotDate. lMetric list Metric-specific metadata use charts reporting. Created passing lWorkflow object gsm.reporting::MakeMetric() turning list. Expected columns: File,MetricID, Group, Abbreviation, Metric, Numerator, Denominator, Model, Score, strThreshold. details see Data Model vignette: vignette("DataModel", package = "gsm.core"). dfGroups data.frame Group-level metadata dictionary. Created passing CTMS site study data gsm.mapping::MakeLongMeta(). Expected columns: GroupID, GroupLevel, Param, Value. vThreshold numeric Threshold value(s). strOutcome character Outcome variable. Default: 'Score'. vOutcomeOptions character Vector outcome options y-axis dropdown. Default: c("Score", "Metric", "Numerator"). Must include strOutcome. bAddGroupSelect logical Add dropdown highlight sites? Default: TRUE. strShinyGroupSelectID character Element ID group select Shiny context. Default: 'GroupID'. strOutputLabel character Label describing output object, assigned output_label attribute output object appears report generated gsm.kri::Report_KRI(). bDebug logical Print debug messages? Default: FALSE. ... Additional chart configuration settings.

text: bDebug logical Print debug messages? Default: FALSE. dfBounds data.frame Set predicted percentages/rates upper- lower-bounds across full range sample sizes/total exposure values reporting. Created passing dfResults dfMetrics gsm.reporting::MakeBounds(). Expected columns: Threshold, Denominator, Numerator, Metric, MetricID, StudyID, SnapshotDate. dfGroups data.frame Group-level metadata dictionary. Created passing CTMS site study data gsm.mapping::MakeLongMeta(). Expected columns: GroupID, GroupLevel, Param, Value. dfMetrics data.frame Metric-specific metadata use charts reporting. Created passing lWorkflow object gsm.reporting::MakeMetric(). Expected columns: File, MetricID, Group, Abbreviation, Metric, Numerator, Denominator, Model, Score, Threshold. details see Data Model vignette: vignette("DataModel", package = "gsm.core"). dfResults data.frame stacked summary analysis pipeline output. Created passing list results returned gsm.core::Summarize() gsm.reporting::BindResults(). Expected columns: GroupID, GroupLevel, Numerator, Denominator, Metric, Score, Flag, MetricID, StudyID, SnapshotDate. lMetric list Metric-specific metadata use charts reporting. Created passing lWorkflow object gsm.reporting::MakeMetric() turning list. Expected columns: File,MetricID, Group, Abbreviation, Metric, Numerator, Denominator, Model, Score, strThreshold. details see Data Model vignette: vignette("DataModel", package = "gsm.core"). strOutputLabel character Label describing output object, assigned output_label attribute output object appears report generated gsm.kri::Report_KRI(). vOutcomeOptions character Vector outcome options y-axis dropdown. Default: c("Score", "Metric", "Numerator"). Must include strOutcome.

title: gsm.vizr 0.1.0
text: Initial release: htmlwidgets interface gsm.viz JavaScript library, hosting chart generations one vendored gsm.viz 2.4.1 bundle. bars()/facet_bars() widgets one vendored bundle. bars_spec()/facet_spec() validation mirroring gsm.viz validateSpec.js; factor levels derive category/stack order automatically. js_hook() function-valued slots, revived allowlist . gsm-viz-select event contract Shiny input mirroring. barsOutput()/renderBars()/bars_proxy() verbs (silent default). html_dependency_gsm_viz() packages’ custom widgets. Relocated legacy KRI widget wrappers gsm.kri (#4): Widget_BarChart, Widget_ScatterPlot, Widget_TimeSeries, Widget_GroupOverview, Shiny bindings, MakeChartConfig(), shared widget-control JS/CSS. Takes gsm.core (>= 1.3.1) Imports, alongside dplyr, fontawesome, lifecycle, magrittr, purrr, rlang, tidyr.
